The language you speak. Automatic uses your phone\'s language. Applies to every mode, the keyboard and shared audio from the next dictation.
Names and words the recogniser gets wrong. Each word heard as one of the alternatives is written your way in every final transcript, and cloud models that accept vocabulary are sent your spellings.

When you change a word the Just Speak to It keyboard has just typed, while the keyboard is still open in that field, the change is noted on this phone. An edit you make often becomes a personal correction. Password fields and fields that ask keyboards not to learn are never read.
Sends the final transcript to the chosen model\'s provider to fix punctuation and spelling. Needs that provider\'s key. If cleanup fails, the original transcript is kept.

Replaces the built-in cleanup instructions, for example to set a tone or format. The transcript is still sent as data, and only the cleaned text is kept. Leave empty for the built-in prompt.

A profile swaps in its own cloud model, language and cleanup for new dictations. Choose one on the dictation screen or the keyboard. A profile never changes the mode, so on-device dictation stays on your phone.

Welcome to Just Speak to It
Speak instead of typing. This short setup allows the microphone, chooses how speech becomes text, adds the dictation keyboard and tile, and runs a test. You can run it again from Settings.
The app records only while you dictate. Android asks once; you can change it later in the app\'s system settings.
On device keeps audio on this device. Speech service uses the recogniser Android provides. Cloud sends audio to the provider you choose, using your own key from Settings. You can change this later.
Turn on the dictation keyboard to dictate into any text field, and add the Dictate tile to Quick Settings to start from anywhere.
The dictation keyboard is on. Switch to it with the keyboard button while typing.
The Dictate tile is in Quick Settings.
To add the tile, swipe down twice from the top of the screen, tap Edit and drag Dictate into place.
Tap the microphone, say a sentence and tap stop. Your text appears below.
Dictate from this screen, the keyboard or the Dictate tile. This setup stays available in Settings.
Walk through microphone access, the speech route, the keyboard and tile, and a test dictation again.
